scope: Questions explicitly request four/five items, each in one sentence. Not an unrestricted long-answer comparison.
Forced native generation with no RAG. Product document-first responses have a different path.
First accepted body time excludes subsequent UI frame scheduling. Native first text is unverified.
One run per question/condition. Screen rendering and recording are combined, not independently profiled.
No claim of 8-9 second completion, improved native decoding throughput, general factual accuracy or all-device performance.
Compose keyboard checks use controlled viewport resizing, not every physical IME.
Preview is a 22 second clip of only the temporary test app. Unrelated apps are excluded.
